name: Ashoka University
summary: Ashoka University is a private liberal-arts research university founded in 2014 near Delhi, built on a collective-philanthropy model with over 200 founders. It offers 25+ undergraduate majors and minors across the humanities, sciences and social sciences, with an unusually large need-based financial aid program relative to most Indian private universities.

applicationFee.value: No application fee for undergraduate applicants

domesticTuition.notes: Tuition component of the official 2025-26 fee structure; residence (≈INR 2 lakh) and service charges are extra. Read via a search summary of the official PDF.

scholarships.name: Ashoka need-based financial aid
scholarships.eligibility: Admitted undergraduates whose family's assessed ability to pay falls short of the cost; families with gross annual income under roughly INR 12–15 lakh are encouraged to apply.
scholarships.coverage: Up to 100% of tuition; the percentage is fixed at admission for the whole programme.

programs.name: BA (Hons) Economics
programs.summary: Economics major within Ashoka's liberal-arts undergraduate programme, admitted through a holistic application (academic record, essays, and an interview for some applicants).
